name: 轻盈印花防水双肩包款
description: 低饱和雾青调印花双肩包：轻盈防水、大容量分层、五金与提手细节背书

styleLock.backgroundSystem: dusty teal seamless panels with lighter horizontal stripes, clean white infographic screens, warm cream info blocks
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio light, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadow, no harsh specular
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper panels and light matte ground; fabric weave texture appears only in macro shots
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, short headlines in 「」, headline 28-48pt, labels 10-14pt
styleLock.iconSystem: thin monoline icons in #2B3A55 inside thin circular outlines, single accent mark per icon
styleLock.presentationRules: full views keep a stable eye-level front 3/4 hero angle, product centered with soft contact shadow; macros switch angle deliberately
noDrift: no serif or handwritten display type
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh youthful ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of dusty teal #B7CDD1 panels, clean white #FFFFFF screens, deep navy #2B3A55 for text and trims, and coral #E8604C as the single accent; soft cool studio lighting with front-left key and gentle contact shadow; modern geometric sans-serif short headlines only; consistent thin circular outline icons; clean product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement with natural breathing room around the product; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 8 张 800×1200 详情页切片提炼。源产品为花卉印花轻量尼龙女士双肩包（防水面料、大容量分层、A4 尺寸对比、提手/压铸五金细节、模特展示位）。已剥离：品牌 LOGO 标识特写、页头页脚灰色条、英文装饰段落与品牌字体、二维码会员浮标、空灰模特占位图、原文案全部改为 callout/selling_point 占位符。品类据图判为 箱包/背包，与源文件夹名一致。与库内 suite-xiangbao-shoutixiekuayinhuabao（手提斜挎印花包）为不同包型：本款为双肩背负式，且以雾青条纹首屏+低饱和印花风格区分。
